Benedíctio, et cláritas, et sapiéntia, e: 阿们。愿赞颂、光荣、智慧、称谢、尊威、权能和勇毅，全归于我们的天主，至于无穷之世。阿们。

Magnificat antiphons (1566-1573): These are drawn from Luke 1 and are liturgical paraphrases rather than verbatim scripture; translated per liturgical conventions rather than strict 思高 fetch. The mediant * has been placed at the natural syntactic division. 2. Index 1591 (1 John 4:16): The Latin 'Deus caritas est: et qui manet in caritate, in Deo manet, et Deus in eo' corresponds to verse 16b; the 思高 text of v.16 begins with 'nous reconnaissons...' — included the full v.16 from 思高 (which combines 16a and 16b). 3. Index 1593 (1 John 5:7 — Comma Johanneum): The 思高 text only has '原来作证的有三个：' for v.7; the Latin Vulgate includes the full Comma Johanneum. Rendered the full Comma in Chinese following the Latin sense with Catholic terminology (圣父、圣言、圣神), noting that this clause is absent from the 思高 critical text but present in the Vulgate. 4. Index 1605 (2 Cor 6): The capitulum omits v.1 of the 思高 text and begins with v.2 content ('ecce nunc tempus acceptabile'), plus adds a phrase about not giving offense (from v.3); translated to match the Latin text as given. 5. 'Deus noster' in index 1560 rendered '我们的天主' (God = 天主). 6. 'Dóminus' in liturgical address rendered '上主' per 思高 psalm usage and per glossary §11 (YHWH/Lord context in scripture). In non-scripture liturgical address, '上主' used consistently per 思高 biblical register for Dominus.
